discriminating_logic: Autistic traits occur in 64.3% of MSL2 mutation individuals, distinctly higher than in MSL3-related Basilicata-Akhtar syndrome.

Motor impairment in MSL2 is dominated by early feeding difficulties (81.3%), axial/truncal hypotonia (76.5%), and gait ataxia (44%) rather than early-onset refractory epileptic encephalopathy or progressive hypertonic spasticity seen in severe KAT8 mutations.
